cohort: 2831 preterm, very low birth weight (VLBW; ≤1500 g) infants from 13 neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) in 5 continents
finding: Early antibiotic treatment within 3 days of birth was associated with a lower incidence of necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) in a large cohort of preterm VLBW infants, even after adjusting for confounding factors.
